messages:
oncall-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: P1 - elevated 429s across api-prod in eu-west-1 after ratecap rollout (rule: rc/v2). Auto-created incident INC-4567.
oncall-bot: Links: https://pagerduty.example/incident/INC-4567 · Runbook: https://runbook.internal/ratecap-rollback
samir: seeing the same in Grafana - 429 spike started ~1762109940. 95th latency ok, but error% jumped to 6.8% on generation endpoints.
marta: tagging infra-oncall. any idea if this is the new rollout or config drift?
devin: last deploy was the ratecap/v2 rollout at 1762109600 (canary -> prod). Canary looked fine, but canary config had exemptions list A; prod uses dynamic exemptions sync from auth. did that sync fail?
samir: quick check: `curl -s https://config-store.internal/ratecap/v2 | jq .exemptions | wc -l` -> returns 0 on prod, 12 on canary. that explains missing exemptions.
natalie: customer reports incoming: Acme & NovaCorp complaining about 429s in support queue. marking high customer impact.
marta: OK action plan: 1) flip feature flag to disable rollout (kill-switch) 2) re-enable exemptions sync or hotpatch config 3) if that fails, rollback 1762109600. Who's on the kill-switch?
samir: I'm oncall and can flip. where's the flag? deploy-bot: `redwood deploy flag status ratecap_v2 = enabled (since 1762109600)`
samir: flipping now -> `redwood flag set ratecap_v2 false --reason "prod exemptions gap causing 429s"`
samir: deploy-bot: FLAG CHANGED: ratecap_v2 set to false by samir at 1762110050. Canary/prod routing will fall back to rc/v1 within ~30s.
devin: seeing drop in 429s in eu-west-1 within 60s to 0.8%. nice. but we still need to reconcile why exemptions sync returned empty.
marta: start mitigation complete checklist in thread. I'll notify support and acct mgmt for Acme/NovaCorp/Zephyr. please capture list of impacted endpoints.
devin: logs snippet from ratecap service (cut):
```
[1762109912] WARN exemptions-sync: auth-service responded 404
[1762109920] ERROR rate-enforcer: token_accounting mismatch: expected=12345 applied=0
[1762109933] INFO rate-enforcer: applied global cap rc/v2
```
samir: token_accounting mismatch looks bad — might be separate bug that zeroed counters during rollout. opening a hotpatch PR to skip the new accounting path.
devin: PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/8923 - patch will fallback to legacy ledger write if accounting check fails.
natalie: support update draft: "We've implemented an emergency mitigation (feature-flag revert) which reduced errors. Our eng team is investigating root cause; we will follow up with timeline and any replay plans." send to customers now?
marta: send now. also set incident severity: P1, page oncall and eng-runtime. samir, you own live mitigation until handoff.
samir: owning. starting deeper forensics: run `kubectl logs -l app=rate-enforcer -n prod --since=15m | grep token_accounting | head -n 200` and pushing metrics to inc dashboard.
devin: found a missing migration in the rollout: prod job that populates exemptions-cache (job id 1342) failed due to RBAC change. job logs show `permission denied` when writing to config-store.
natalie: that explains empty exemptions. acct mgmt says Acme reported about 620 failed requests over 8 minutes, NovaCorp ~110, Zephyr ~40. impact limited to a small set of enterprise customers but high per-customer.
marta: next steps: 1) fix RBAC and re-run job 1342 2) run config sync and validate exemptions count 3) re-enable flag if green 4) run postmortem. assign owners: RBAC fix -> devin, job rerun & validation -> samir, postmortem -> marta.
samir: reran job 1342 with temporary elevated service account at 1762110300; now `curl .../exemptions | jq . | length` -> 12. applying to prod rate-enforcer cache.
devin: after applying exemptions back, 429s are at baseline. I'll keep an eye for token_accounting errors — pushing a canary with the hotpatch to prod-lite cluster.
marta: support & acct mgmt notified. created incident channel #inc-4567 and invited relevant folks. creating Jira INC-4567-ticket.
natalie: any immediate rollback? sounds we didn't need full rollback because flag flip worked. good.
samir: handing off to marta at 1762110500 — I'm signing out of incident rotation. summary: flag flip mitigated; root cause: exemptions sync failed due to RBAC, token_accounting mismatch observed during roll. action items above.
marta: taking over oncall for the incident for next 6 hours. I'll coordinate postmortem and confirm deploy gating changes to prevent RBAC regressions.
deploy-bot: Deploy monitoring note: re-enabling ratecap_v2 should only proceed after exemptions job success and no token_accounting errors for >=30m.
marta: noted. closing pager for now; will update INC-4567 with timeline and RCA draft. :white_check_mark:
